### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Source: CENTRAL_BANK_COMPANY in the generator -- 49 of E&F's bank
### companies, the ones that were their country's actual central bank, checked
### against the tag E&F grants each of them in establish_bank_and_ef_compagnie.
###
### NOT all 97, and that is the whole point. `building_types` is the only real
### lock on who may own a building: while every bank company carried
### building_bank, Banca d'Italia privatised four levels of the Papal central
### bank away from the company holding the monopoly. A monopoly is a price and
### construction rule; this list is the lock.
###
### These keep the assets they already own -- the Banque de France comes with
### its ten levels of private construction and five of the Bourse de Paris -- and
### the generated per-currency company is used only where no historical central
### bank exists. See zz_ef_cm_generic_banks.txt.
###
### INJECT: so E&F's own building list and its own prestige goods survive. Those
### sit on other base goods (manufacture_stock and friends) and never compete
### with the three currencies, which all share spe_uni_c.
###
### company_BasicBank gets the building and no currency: it is the fallback owner
### for a country with neither a historical central bank nor a currency law.

	possible_prestige_goods = {
